gloss: role; part (in a play or situation)

definitions.gloss: role; part (in a play, film, or performance)
definitions.explanation: The specific character or part that an actor plays. Implies the nature and importance of the role.

definitions.gloss: role; function; part to play (in a situation)
definitions.explanation: One's role or expected function in a group, project, or situation. Used figuratively beyond the performing arts.

examples.japanese: {難|むずか}しい{役|やく}どころだ。
{今回|こんかい}の{映画|えいが}では{悪役|あくやく}の{役|やく}どころだ。
examples.english: In this movie, I play the villain's role.

examples.japanese: あの{俳優|はいゆう}は{主人公|しゅじんこう}の{親友|しんゆう}という{重要|じゅうよう}な{役|やく}どころを{演|えん}じた。
examples.english: That actor played the important role of the protagonist's best friend.

examples.japanese: チームでの{自分|じぶん}の{役|やく}どころを{考|かんが}えた。
examples.english: I thought about my role on the team.

examples.japanese: この{会議|かいぎ}での{私|わたし}の{役|やく}どころは{進行|しんこう}だ。
examples.english: My role in this meeting is to facilitate.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}はプロジェクトの{中|なか}で{調整役|ちょうせいやく}という{役|やく}どころを{担|にな}っている。
examples.english: He plays the role of coordinator in the project.

notes:
{役|やく}どころ originally comes from theater and film but is commonly used in everyday contexts to talk about one's function or expected contribution.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {役|やく}どころを{演|えん}じる — to play a role
- {役|やく}どころを{担|にな}う — to take on a role
- {重要|じゅうよう}な{役|やく}どころ — an important role
- {難|むずか}しい{役|やく}どころ — a difficult role

RELATED WORDS:
- {役割|やくわり} — role, function
- {配役|はいやく} — casting, role assignment
- {出番|でばん} — one's turn to appear
